assessment: In this valuable report, the authors investigated the effect of mitochondrial transplantation on post-cardiac arrest myocardial dysfunction (PAMD), which is associated with mitochondrial dysfunction. They convincingly demonstrated that mitochondrial transplantation enhanced cardiac function and increased survival rates after the return of spontaneous circulation (ROSC). They have also shown that myocardial tissues with transplanted mitochondria exhibited increased mitochondrial complex activity, higher ATP levels, reduced cardiomyocyte apoptosis, and lower myocardial oxidative stress post-ROSC.
